name: Lilly
source:
When Lilly and her [url=https://vndb.org/c170780]twin brother[/url] were babies, their parents got into a tragic car accident while coming back from a date night. An old man had a heart attack with his foot on the gas and ran a red light, smashing into their car as they crossed an intersection. The old man and Lilly's father died on impact, her mother later died in the hospital from collapsed lungs and internal hemorrhaging. Lilly's [url=https://vndb.org/c170781]grandfather[/url] was their only remaining family, and so he took on the responsibility to raise them.

During the Evermore Festival, Lilly took a trip to Walton from out of town to go have fun with all the activities. They were having a blast at the festival, [spoiler]until a soulrender killed her brother and grandfather. Luckily for Lilly, [url=https://vndb.org/c131856]Natalie[/url] heard her screams and quickly came to her rescue. Natalie reassured her to the best of her ability, but there was only so much she could do for a child who had just witnessed her only family being killed before her. Because of her connections in the police force, Natalie was able to quickly get temporary custody with the intent to adopt her. Natalie is doing her best to keep her distracted by teaching her Karate and letting her play with her new unicorn and thinking of other things than her dead family. Thankfully, Lilly took a liking to Natalie quickly. It gives her somebody to comfort her at night when the nightmares come.[/spoiler]

[In game description]
